title.narrative: Indigenous Governance and Forest Protection in the Brazilian Amazon

description.narrative: Indigenous communities living in the Brazilian state of Rondônia, and their representative organizations.

The overall objective is to strengthen the protection of the Amazon by supporting Indigenous communities and their representative organizations in safeguarding their territories, forests, and collective rights.
The project seeks to enhance territorial autonomy through improved food security and sovereignty, sustainable livelihoods, and stronger institutional engagement, while reinforcing local capacities to prevent and respond to illegal logging and other environmental threats. It will promote biodiversity conservation and forest protection—particularly through sustainable practices such as agroforestry systems—while strengthening organizational capacity, advancing equality and inclusive participation.
